subject: Pinwheel RFI: evidence mapping and delivery plan
messages:
From: Marie Dubois <marie.dubois@datavista.com>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.example.com>
Cc: Pinwheel Legal <legal@pinwheel.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pinwheel - SOC2/ISO/SIG evidence request (RFI)

Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — great run-through of Dedicated capacity and the private deployment options. Our procurement team asked me to collect the evidence package for the SIG questionnaire follow-up. They want a short control crosswalk showing where Redwood maps SIG questions to SOC 2 and ISO 27001 controls, and then the specific artifacts you can provide for each control (logs, configs, runbooks, attestations).

Can you confirm:
- Whether you can split answers between Hosted/Dedicated/Private variants where the control impact differs.
- Typical SLAs for dedicated customers and whether you can provide a sample SLA attachment.
- Any constraints on sharing redacted logs or telemetry slices for audit purposes.

We're on a tight timeline: internal intake on Monday (2026-03-16). If possible, could you send a crosswalk and a list of deliverables + owner for each artifact by EOD Friday (2026-03-13)?

Appreciate it — happy to hop on a 30m call if that helps.

Best,
Marie
Marie Dubois
Senior Procurement Manager, Pinwheel
marie.dubois@datavista.com

Marie — thanks, we can do this. Looping in Kimberly (security lead) and Neha (assurance ops) who will own the control mapping and artifact collection.

Quick answers up front:
- We will provide a SIG-to-SOC2/ISO crosswalk and indicate Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private where controls differ.
- We can include our standard Dedicated SLA PDF and call out deviations for Private deployments.
- We can share redacted telemetry/log extracts; certain raw PII-bearing logs require a DPA addendum and redaction step handled by our security team.

Kimberly/Neha — can you confirm owners and whether the crosswalk + artifacts list is deliverable by EOD Friday (COB 03/13)? I can prioritize with Pinwheel and schedule a 30m intake if needed.

Thanks,
Rishi

Hi all — I will lead the crosswalk and artifact catalog. Priyom, please own the technical artifact pulls (logs, KV-cache proof, sample telemetry) and Neha please coordinate legal/DPAs and final redactions.

Planned deliverables (short):
- pinwheel_control_crosswalk_v1.csv — mapping SIG sections to SOC2 common criteria and ISO 27001 clauses, with a short "evidence available" column (Hosted/Dedicated/Private).
- redwood_soc2_iso_summary.pdf — 1-page answer summary + list of available artifacts and retention windows.
- pack: kms_key_rotation_log_excerpt.txt (redacted), network_arch_diagram_v1.png (stub), ci_cd_runbook_excerpt.txt.

Constraints:
- For Hosted customers we can provide process docs and aggregated telemetry; raw logs with customer identifiers need a signed DPA + timeboxed access.
- For Private deployments we can grant deeper access under an enterprise onboarding agreement; SLA language differs by contract.

I expect the CSV + PDF by EOD Friday. Priyom, can you confirm you will attach the three artifact excerpts and a Drive link?

-Kimberly
Head of Security & Compliance — Redwood Inference

Thanks — I reviewed the CSV and PDF briefly and they look good. Two quick clarifications before I present to procurement: 

1) Under SIG section 2.4 (Data Access & Segmentation) you marked "Hosted: aggregation only" and "Dedicated: per-tenant logs available" — can you confirm the retention period for per-tenant logs on Dedicated (days)? Also, will the redaction step remove all hashed identifiers or just PII fields?
2) On the SLA: can you confirm the latency SLO for inference at 99th percentile for our Dedicated profile (8x A100 equivalent)? Procurement wants a numeric ms number for 99p.

If possible, can we get those two items by EOD today? Otherwise we'll need to escalate to legal for a contract-level clarification.

Best,
Marie

From: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.example.com>
To: Marie Dubois <marie.dubois@datavista.com>
Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.example.com>, neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.example.com>, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.example.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Mar 2026 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pinwheel - SOC2/ISO/SIG evidence request (RFI)

Marie — quick answers and owners: 

- Per-tenant log retention on Dedicated: default 90 days (configurable up to 365 days under enterprise commit). Redaction approach: Priyom will redact PII fields (names, emails, raw tokens); we also salt+hash identifiers and can provide a hashed-only slice if you need linkage without re-identification.
- 99th percentile inference latency for Dedicated (8x A100 equivalent): 240 ms for prompt+100 tokens under steady-state workload (this is verified in our Dedicated benchmark profile; I'll attach the SLA snippet if useful).

Kimberly/Neha/Priyom — please attach the SLA excerpt and a short note on the redaction process for the procurement packet. I'll upload a combined ZIP to the Drive link and share the HubSpot deal.

If you'd like a 20m call to run procurement through the answers, I can do 10:30 PT tomorrow.

Thanks,
Rishi
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
